result.instructions: Tools for Exely, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which bookings changed in the last 24 hours, and what are their arrival dates?"; "Show the daily occupancy for our property from 1 to 7 November."; "What are the cancellation rules for our rooms?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Exely data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run exely_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run exely_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run exely_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. exely_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: exely_list_properties
tools.title: List properties
tools.description: List the properties that this API connection can read, with their ids. Start here to find a propertyId. Pass include='All' for the hotel info, room types, rate plans and services. Exely API: GET /api/content/v1/properties.

since.description: Continue from the 'next' value of the previous answer. Omit it for the first page.

include.description: 'All' adds the hotel info, room types, rate plans and services. Omit it for ids only.

languageCode.description: Language of the texts. Only 'en' is allowed. Omit it for the property's language.

tools.name: exely_get_property
tools.title: Get property
tools.description: Get the description of one property: name, address, contacts and content. Exely API: GET /api/content/v1/properties/{propertyId}.

propertyId.description: The Exely property id, as exely_list_properties returns it.

languageCode.description: Language of the texts. Only 'en' is allowed. Omit it for the property's language.

tools.name: exely_get_cancellation_rules
tools.title: Get cancellation rules
tools.description: Get the cancellation rules that the property set for its bookings. Exely API: GET /api/content/v1/properties/{propertyId}/cancellation-rules.

propertyId.description: The Exely property id, as exely_list_properties returns it.

tools.name: exely_get_extra_stay_rules
tools.title: Get early check-in and late check-out rules
tools.description: Get the early check-in and late check-out rules of one property. Exely API: GET /api/content/v1/properties/{propertyId}/extra-stay-rules.

propertyId.description: The Exely property id, as exely_list_properties returns it.

annotations.title: Get early check-in and late check-out rules

tools.name: exely_list_room_type_categories
tools.title: List room type categories
tools.description: List the room type categories that Exely uses (for example single, double, suite). Exely API: GET /api/content/v1/room-type-categories.

tools.name: exely_list_meal_plans
tools.title: List meal plans
tools.description: List the meal plan options that Exely uses (for example breakfast included). Exely API: GET /api/content/v1/meal-plans.

tools.name: exely_list_rooms
tools.title: List rooms
tools.description: List the rooms and suites of one property, with their room type. Use pageToken from the previous answer to read the next page. Exely API: GET /api/pms/v2/properties/{propertyId}/rooms.

propertyId.description: The Exely property id, as exely_list_properties returns it.

roomTypeId.description: Only the rooms of this room type id.

pageToken.description: Token from the previous answer. When you send it, the other filters are ignored.

tools.name: exely_list_bookings
tools.title: List booking summaries
tools.description: List booking summaries of one property, by last modification time. Pass lastModification (UTC) for the first call, or continueToken from the previous answer, not both. Without either, the search starts in 2009 and can return many bookings. Exely API: GET /api/read-reservation/v1/properties/{propertyId}/bookings.

propertyId.description: The Exely property id, as exely_list_properties returns it.

lastModification.description: Start of the search, by last modification time (UTC). Use it for the first call only.

continueToken.description: Token from the previous answer. Use it to read the next page and the changes after it.

tools.name: exely_get_booking
tools.title: Get booking
tools.description: Get the details of one booking: dates, room stays, rates, services, totals, status and guest names. Exely API: GET /api/read-reservation/v1/properties/{propertyId}/bookings/{number}.

propertyId.description: The Exely property id, as exely_list_properties returns it.

number.description: The Exely booking number, as exely_list_bookings returns it.

tools.name: exely_get_booking_by_external_number
tools.title: Get booking by external number
tools.description: Get the details of one booking by its external number from a booking channel (for example an OTA booking id) and the channel code. Exely API: GET /api/read-reservation/v1/properties/{propertyId}/bookings/by-external-number.

propertyId.description: The Exely property id, as exely_list_properties returns it.

externalNumber.description: The booking number that the channel gave the booking.

channelCode.description: The code of the booking channel that gave the external number.

tools.name: exely_get_daily_occupancy
tools.title: Get daily occupancy
tools.description: Get the daily occupancy statistics of one property for a stay period. The period is at most 31 days. Pass otbDate to count only the bookings that existed on that date (on-the-books view). Exely API: GET /api/pms-analytics/v1/properties/{propertyId}/daily-occupancy.

propertyId.description: The Exely property id, as exely_list_properties returns it.

startStayDate.description: First stay date of the period, e.g. 2026-11-01.

endStayDate.description: Last stay date of the period, e.g. 2026-11-07. At most 31 days after startStayDate.
